 Best PS5 Role-Playing Game on PS Plus Getting Big Free Update
 Zarmena Khan 2026년 10월 21일 수 오후 12:58 UTC 0 Update: The update is live. Read the patch notes here .
 Original story follows… 
 The best and most popular PS5 role-playing game on PS Plus is surprising players with another free update, and it’s a big one. CD Projekt RED will fully reveal Cyberpunk 2077 update 2.5 in a livestream today, but an overview was leaked by a content creator with early access.
 What we know about PS Plus game Cyberpunk 2077’s incoming update 2.5
 As a reminder, this is just a brief rundown of what Cyberpunk 2077 update 2.5 entails. Further details will be shared by CD Projekt RED at 11 a.m. ET / 8 a.m. PT.
 Advertisement
 Without further ado, here are the highlights (via Reddit ): 
 New Cyberpunk Edgerunners quest called Clampdown
 New Night City tour mystery side quest
 Dual Wielding pistols in Cool Tree (Double Trouble perk)
 Five new clothing sets
 New radio station with Edgerunners soundtrack
 Five new Glamdocs to customize arm and hand cyberware
 New hairstyles for male and female V
 Mod.io support on all major platforms, including PS5
 Adds field-of-view slider on consoles
 Tune into the livestream below for more details and complete patch notes:
 Cyberpunk 2077 was added to the PS Plus Extra catalog in July 2025. It’s unclear when the game will be removed from the service, but since it’s already past the one-year mark, we’re hoping that Sony signed a two-year contract with CD Projekt RED.
 The post Best PS5 Role-Playing Game on PS Plus Getting Big Free Update appeared first on PlayStation LifeStyle .
